automation_boundary.automated_scope: Login page -> Select OTP tab (default) -> Enter registered username/email -> Click CONTINUE / RECEIVE OTP -> Fill the 6-digit OTP boxes (1 to 6) -> Land on Organization Selection or authenticated Dashboard 360.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: OTP generation and delivery via SMS/email is external. Automated execution requires the test runner to provide a valid test OTP code; accessing external mailboxes is out of scope.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The login page loads with the 'Sign in using OTP' tab selected by default and the email field visible

canonical_steps.action: Enter the registered username or email address
canonical_steps.expected_result: The email is populated and the CONTINUE button becomes actionable

canonical_steps.action: Click CONTINUE to request the one-time password
canonical_steps.expected_result: The 'Enter your One Time Password' screen appears showing the masked email, mobile number, and six OTP digit boxes

canonical_steps.action: Enter the six-digit OTP, one digit per box, in boxes 1 through 6
canonical_steps.expected_result: All six digit boxes are filled, a green checkmark appears, and verification is submitted

canonical_steps.action: Select the target organization if prompted on multi-organization screen
canonical_steps.expected_result: The organization is selected and the user navigates to the authenticated Dashboard

canonical_steps.action: Verify the authenticated B2B Portal Dashboard is displayed
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Dashboard 360 loads displaying the account metrics and the user profile in the top navigation

test_data_notes.attribute_spelling: The OTP input name attribute is 'opt-field' in the Angular application DOM.
test_data_notes.primary_test_user: ayishabcrm@gmail.com or registered QA customer representative
